When implementing a catalog entry, define trigger, inputs, outputs, platform, account or plan requirements, dependencies, permissions, fallbacks, tests, and packaging rules. Combine skills only when they share a clear workflow, asset model, or output type. Cloud presentation features vary by plan, region, browser, administrator policy, AI credits, and staged rollout.
